body.prompt: Daylight in a hazy marble colonnade, a white-bearded old scholar in a cream toga sits beside the Roman emperor in a crimson cloak and speaks gently to him, a huge column base in the foreground.

Daylight medium shot between tall stone columns, an old white-bearded scholar turns toward the bearded Roman emperor in a crimson cloak, who listens with his head slightly bowed, soft sunlit haze behind.
Daylight close two-shot in a sunlit colonnade, the Roman emperor with grey curly hair lowers his eyes and slowly nods while the old white-bearded scholar beside him watches with a faint smile.

Night in a firelit stone hall, a smiling courtier in a blue robe leans in and holds out a bronze wine cup to the Roman emperor seated on a carved wooden chair, a brazier flame burning at the edge of the frame.
Night medium shot in a torchlit stone hall, the bearded Roman emperor in a crimson cloak sits still in a carved chair and looks up at the man offering him a bronze cup, warm firelight on the wall.
Night close-up by warm firelight of the Roman emperor's calm face, grey curly hair and beard, as he holds the bronze wine cup he has just accepted, carved chair back behind him.
Bright morning daylight outside the Colosseum, ordinary Romans in tunics stream past its great stone arches while a young woman sets out clay bowls on a stall, a sunlit stone ledge in the foreground.
Daylight in front of the Colosseum arches, a young woman vendor arranges terracotta bowls and jugs on a low stall as townspeople walk by behind her in dusty morning light.
Daylight close shot of a young Roman woman in a linen tunic arranging stacks of clay bowls beside tall jugs on a wooden stall, a blurred crowd passing before the Colosseum arches behind her.
